_comment: Vinted ids of items that sold BEFORE this pipeline existed, so the diff never saw them
disappear. sync-vinted.mjs fetches each one once, recovers its real title, description
and photo from the Open Graph tags that survive on a sold listing page, and files it in
archive.json. After that it is never fetched again.
You should not normally need to add to this. From now on anything that sells is caught
automatically by comparing each sync against the previous catalog.
These seven were hardcoded on the old hand-built clothes page and had already sold —
they were live dead links on the site until the catalog replaced it.
